findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Define a cleanup path for bank dirs orphaned by a crash-before-finalize (e.g. a startup sweep of .rebar/workflow_runs/ for stale run_ids, or a TTL/reap policy), so the RETIRE path covers non-finalize exits and the dir cannot accumulate.

The retirement is conditioned on reaching finalize; a crash/kill before finalize is a state the plan closes for the VERDICT (verdict-less trap) but not for the on-disk bank dir
T9 checklist: 'There is a RETIRE/cleanup path — it doesn't leak/accumulate'
findings.finding: The bank dir RETIRE path is defined only for the finalize path ('discarded after finalize'), but a run that crashes before reaching finalize (hard process kill, OOM, non-typed failure) leaves its .rebar/workflow_runs/<run_id>/bank/ dir on disk with no cleanup, accumulating stale run dirs over time.
findings.location: Run-scoped bank — 'The bank dir is discarded after finalize'
scenarios: A long-running server (remote MCP shape) executing many close attempts, some of which crash before finalize, slowly accumulates orphaned per-run bank dirs under .rebar/workflow_runs/ that are never reaped
findings.suggested_fix: Add a bounded reaper: on executor startup (or before minting a new run bank), sweep .rebar/workflow_runs/ and remove bank dirs whose run_id is not the active run and whose mtime exceeds a configured TTL.
